description: Displays Oware Abapa positions and plays out games and endgames.

attributes.name: interactive
attributes.description: Enables human moves by clicking, tapping or keyboard.

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Side to move, twelve pit counts in sowing order, and South/North scores.

methods.name: clear(): void
methods.description: Empties the board and scores and stops play.

methods.name: flip(): void
methods.description: Reverses the view without changing the active or human side.

methods.name: highlightLegalMove(show = true): number[]
methods.description: Highlights and returns legal pits. Pass false to clear highlights.

methods.name: legalMove(pit: number): boolean
methods.description: Tests whether a pit can be sown without changing the position.

methods.name: legalMoves(): number[]
methods.description: Returns all playable pit numbers (1–12), including compulsory feeding restrictions.

methods.name: move(pit: number): boolean
methods.description: Sows one pit and applies captures and end-of-game collection. Returns false for illegal input.

methods.name: nextMove(): boolean
methods.description: Replays one recorded move, or chooses one random legal move at the end of the recording.

methods.name: play(mode: WariPlayMode = "user/random", userSide: WariSide = "south", delay = 2000): boolean
methods.description: Starts user/random or random/random play. Default delay is 2000 ms; allowed range is 100–60000 ms.

methods.name: playToEnd(): boolean
methods.description: Replays the continuation and then plays randomly until the game ends or is paused.

methods.name: previousMove(): boolean
methods.description: Undoes one complete turn, restoring seeds, scores and repetition state.

methods.name: reset(): void
methods.description: Restores the loaded exercise, clearing recorded moves.

methods.name: rewind(): void
methods.description: Returns to the loaded beginning, retaining recorded moves for replay.

methods.name: setPosition(value: string | WariPosition): boolean
methods.description: Loads a serialized position or an object with twelve pits, two scores and a turn. Invalid input preserves the previous game.

methods.name: start(): void
methods.description: Loads the standard four-seeds-per-pit starting position.

methods.name: stop(): void
methods.description: Stops automatic play while preserving the current board and recorded continuation.

events.name: tp-wari-change
events.description: Emitted after loading, playing or navigating a position.
events.detail: { position: string; pits: number[]; scores: number[]; turn: string }

events.name: tp-wari-end
events.description: Emitted when a played move ends the game.

events.name: tp-wari-error
events.description: Emitted for invalid positions or play parameters; the previous game remains unchanged.

events.name: tp-wari-move
events.description: Emitted after a complete sowing turn and its captures.
events.detail: { number: number; side: string; from: number; to: number; seeds: number; path: number[]; captures: { pit: number; seeds: number }[]; grandSlam: boolean; collected: number[]; before: string; after: string }

dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

dependencies.summary: Button component that supports native button and link rendering.

dependencies.summary: Visual separator for menus, dropdowns, toolbars, and layouts.

dependencies.name: tp-theme
dependencies.summary: Parent-scoped light/dark/auto theme controller with embedded UI.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-wari>` element displays Oware Abapa positions and plays out games and endgames.
userHelp.interactions:
The header shows the game icon and name on the left. Rounded controls appear on the right, in this order: Reset, Undo, Redo, Help, chronometer, Color, Theme and Fullscreen. Additional game commands remain below the header.

#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| :tp-icon:{name="refresh"} Reset | Restores the loaded position or puzzle and resets the timer. |
| :tp-icon:{name="undo"} Undo | Takes back the last move. |
| :tp-icon:{name="redo"} Redo | Replays the next undone move. Disabled when there is no recorded continuation. |
| :tp-icon:{name="help"} Help | Opens the dropdown of assistance actions specific to this game. |
| Help → Highlight legal pits | Marks pits that can be sown, including feeding restrictions. |
| Help → Play one random legal move | Pauses and replays the next recorded turn, or chooses a random legal turn at the end of history. |
| Help → Rules of the game | Opens a drawer with the rules of this game. |
| Chronometer | Displays elapsed play time; starts with play and pauses on completion. Reset clears it. |
| :tp-icon:{name="palette-swatch"} Color | Changes the brand color of this game only. |
| :tp-icon:{name="sun"} :tp-icon:{name="moon"} Theme | Changes the light, dark or automatic theme of this game only. |
| :tp-icon:{name="fullscreen"} :tp-icon:{name="fullscreen-exit"} Fullscreen | Enters or leaves fullscreen for this game. |
| Click or tap a legal pit | Sows all of its seeds and applies captures. Available only for the active side when human input is enabled; feeding the opponent is compulsory when possible. |
| Start | Loads four seeds in each of the twelve pits, resets both scores and gives South the turn. |
| Flip | Displays the other player at the bottom without changing the active side. |
| Play vs random | Plays the side currently at the bottom against random legal replies. Enables human input. |
| Random vs random | Plays random legal moves for both sides, one turn every two seconds by default. |
| Stop | Stops automatic play without discarding the board or history. |
| Clear | Removes all seeds, resets both scores and stops play. |
| :tp-icon:{name="chevron-left-first"} Back to beginning | Pauses and restores the loaded beginning, keeping recorded moves for replay. |
| :tp-icon:{name="previous"} Previous move | Pauses and takes back one complete turn, restoring seeds and scores. |
| :tp-icon:{name="next"} Play one move | Pauses and replays one recorded turn, or plays a random legal move if no recording remains. |
| :tp-icon:{name="play"} Play to end | Replays recorded turns and continues randomly until the game ends or Pause is pressed. |
| :tp-icon:{name="pause"} Pause | Stops playback without losing the current position or recorded continuation. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Moves between the toolbar, board and playback controls. The board has one tab stop. |
| <kbd>←</kbd> / <kbd>→</kbd> / <kbd>↑</kbd> / <kbd>↓</kbd> | Moves focus between pits in the displayed direction, without wrapping at edges. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Sows the focused legal pit when human input is enabled, or activates a focused toolbar button. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Opens User help for the component under the pointer, falling back to focus. <kbd>Shift</kbd> may be needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Opens contextual component documentation. |
